test_is_first_distinct: test the is_first_distinct method on a LazyFrame column to mark first occurrence of each distinct value
test_is_last_distinct: test the is_last_distinct method on a Series to mark last occurrence of each distinct value
test_is_first_distinct_various_types: test is_first_distinct on numeric, string, boolean, struct, and list series with null values
test_is_first_last_distinct_list: test is_first_distinct and is_last_distinct on list-typed columns with nested data and nulls
test_is_first_last_distinct_nested_list_: test that is_first_distinct raises InvalidOperationError for nested list inner types
